subagentStatusLine.command: jq -c '.tasks[]? | select((.agentType // "") | startswith("epico:")) | {id, content: ("[epico] " + (.agentType | ltrimstr("epico:")) + (if (.label // "") != "" then " · " + .label else "" end) + " · " + ((((.tokenCount // 0) / 100) | floor) / 10 | tostring) + "k tokens")}'
